claims.evidence: Instrument per file from raw header; dissociation from Methods (XL CID, Velos/QE HCD); tolerances from parameters.txt (FTMS 20 ppm, ITMS 0.5 Da). Velos HCD read as Orbitrap (FTMS) is assumed.

claims.value: phospho for Velos/QE files, not applicable for XL files
claims.evidence: Methods: XL for total protein, Velos and Q-Exactive for phospho-enriched samples

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl fixed; Oxidation, N-term acetyl, Deamidated, Phospho, SILAC labels variable

claims.evidence: Methods trypsin (LysC then trypsin for in-solution); summary.txt Protease Trypsin/P. PRIDE record does not name it (reconcile BLOCKER cleavage_agent_unsupported, overridden).

claims.value: SDS PAGE for gel series; not available otherwise
claims.evidence: Gel digestion stated for proteome; fraction numbers taken from the trailing index of file names

limitations: No per-file sample sheet exists; file-to-sample mapping is derived from MaxQuant evidence.txt Experiment plus file-name tokens (CE, NP, NF1, OffGel, TiO2_Digest, Ti, Phospho, PIPE) whose meaning is not defined in the paper.
CE/NP are likely cytoplasmic/nuclear fractions but this is not stated; they appear only as literal tokens in source names.
Fraction numbering for TiO2_Digest, Ti, PIPE and Phospho series, and technical replicate numbers for Digest1_2, PIPE and 20120817 series, are conventions, not stated facts.
Precursor tolerance, passage number, culture medium, storage temperature, ancestry and developmental stage are not available.
Induction medium composition is not stated in the paper text; treatment is described generically.
Fragment tolerance for Velos HCD files assumes Orbitrap detection.
